mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupon_template ( id, coupon_code, name, discount_type, threshold_amount_yuan, discount_amount_yuan, discount_rate, max_discount_amount_yuan, total_quantity, remaining_quantity, per_user_limit, scope_type, receive_start_at, receive_end_at, valid_start_at, valid_end_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{couponCode}, #{name}, #{discountType}, #{thresholdAmountYuan}, #{discountAmountYuan}, #{discountRate}, #{maxDiscountAmountYuan}, #{totalQuantity}, #{remainingQuantity}, #{perUserLimit}, #{scopeType}, #{receiveStartAt}, #{receiveEndAt}, #{validStartAt}, #{validEndAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon_template SET coupon_code = #{couponCode}, name = #{name}, discount_type = #{discountType}, threshold_amount_yuan = #{thresholdAmountYuan}, discount_amount_yuan = #{discountAmountYuan}, discount_rate = #{discountRate}, max_discount_amount_yuan = #{maxDiscountAmountYuan}, total_quantity = #{totalQuantity}, remaining_quantity = #{remainingQuantity}, per_user_limit = #{perUserLimit}, scope_type = #{scopeType}, receive_start_at = #{receiveStartAt}, receive_end_at = #{receiveEndAt}, valid_start_at = #{validStartAt}, valid_end_at = #{validEndAt}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'DISABLED')
mapper.select: SELECT encode(id, 'hex') AS "id", coupon_code AS "couponCode", name, discount_type AS "discountType", threshold_amount_yuan AS "thresholdAmountYuan", discount_amount_yuan AS "discountAmountYuan", discount_rate AS "discountRate", max_discount_amount_yuan AS "maxDiscountAmountYuan", total_quantity AS "totalQuantity", remaining_quantity AS "remainingQuantity", per_user_limit AS "perUserLimit", scope_type AS "scopeType", receive_start_at AS "receiveStartAt", receive_end_at AS "receiveEndAt", valid_start_at AS "validStartAt", valid_end_at AS "validEndAt", status, version, created_at AS "createdAt", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM coupon_template WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon_template SET status = 'ACTIVE', version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'DISABLED')
UPDATE coupon_template SET status = 'DISABLED', version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE coupon_template SET status = 'DELETED', version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'DISABLED', 'EXPIRED')

WITH incoming AS ( SELECT decode(raw.coupon_id_hex, 'hex') AS coupon_id, raw.remaining_quantity AS remaining_quantity FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{itemsJson} AS jsonb)) AS raw( coupon_id_hex text, remaining_quantity integer ) ) UPDATE coupon_template t SET remaining_quantity = GREATEST(0, i.remaining_quantity), updated_at = NOW() FROM incoming i WHERE t.id = i.coupon_id AND t.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'DISABLED', 'EXPIRED')
UPDATE coupon_template SET status = 'EXPIRED', version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND receive_end_at < NOW()
